probes.What is a toothbrush?: A toothbrush is a tool used to clean teeth, tongue, and gums. It consists of a handle and a head with bristles, which are small, flexible filaments. The bristles help to remove plaque and other debris from the teeth, while the handle allows the user to control the movement of the bristles. Toothbrushes come in various shapes and sizes, and they can be manual or electric. They are an essential tool for maintaining good oral hygiene and preventing dental problems such as cavities, gum disease, and bad breath.

probes.What is dental floss?: Dental floss is a thin, flexible thread used to clean between teeth and along the gum line. It is made from various materials, including nylon, polypropylene, or Teflon, and is designed to remove food particles, plaque, and other debris that can cause dental problems. Dental floss is an essential tool for maintaining oral hygiene and preventing dental issues such as cavities, gum disease, and bad breath.
probes.What are human teeth made of?: Human teeth are made of several layers of hard tissue, primarily composed of calcium and phosphate. The hard outer layer is called enamel, the harder inner layer is dentin, and the innermost layer is called pulp, which contains nerves and blood vessels. The enamel is the hardest substance in the human body and it protects the more delicate dentin and pulp. Teeth also have a root canal that extends from the crown of the tooth down into the bone, which contains nerves and blood vessels that provide nutrients to the tooth.
